notes.title: TheLast Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26008660/a5fc513185d93eae11c29a57162fa0ad54d925ec.png
In last update game added new lighting system. "The Last" now offer realistic bloom which affects a better quality graphics at constant volumes of FPS. We added a photo-realistic fog and film tonemapping now graphics look better than before. Game now have new shades of color which that add realism to the game. "The Last" now offer better optimizations than before. Game now have "Depth of field" effect the effect, which affects the visibility of close objects.
Game have new shadow, which are higher
quality than before.
The results you can see below: 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26008660/97f0ba01759a6e3b40285d1ab1219a1852bd84ea.png

Next Update: 2017-01-20.
Next update will have new grass, tree, textures and new two maps.
